hypothesis: The tracked source and analysis snapshots reproduce the reported baseline counts and compiled manuscript.
result: Counts and PDF reproduced only when the expanded issuer file is passed explicitly; the DSL script default points to an older input.
description: Baseline reproduction exposed a traceable pipeline-default defect without changing the research result.

hypothesis: Gold-case evidence identifiers resolve and the cited packet is locally or remotely reconstructable.
result: 94/94 identifiers resolved; 93/94 complete local packets; 94/94 complete recovery URLs; 62/94 exact memo matches
description: The evidence chain is strongly traceable, with one incomplete local packet and 32 cases lacking exact evidence-memo matches.

hypothesis: The DSL default can select the authoritative expanded issuer input and reproduce the explicit run.
result: Default and explicit runs are byte-identical and reproduce 61 overlap and 97 non-overlap issuers.
description: Repairs the stale default input and adds a regression test without changing a research result.

hypothesis: Every reported empirical quantity matches its generated source.
result: 30 of 33 quantities match; three effect sizes require correction from 6.3, 17.1, and 13.5 to 6.6, 16.1, and 12.5 percentage points.
description: Creates a strict source-to-prose numerical audit and preserves all mismatches.

hypothesis: The frozen adjusted historical-capacity analysis is sufficiently identified and stable for interpretation.
result: The adjusted design is rank deficient, has 12 events, excludes six low-capacity nominal exits, and changes sign in 9 of 78 leave-one-out runs.
uncertainty: fixed specifications; no selection by sign or significance
description: Preserves the adverse identification result and limits the current analysis to descriptive association.

hypothesis: Current human and surrogate artifacts identify selected-overlap concordance but not population error rates.
result: Observed concordance is 61/61; target-population precision, recall, calibration, four-category error, sampling error, and inter-coder agreement are not identified.
description: Separates observed agreement from the quantities requiring a probability validation sample and independent human coding.

hypothesis: The proposed 133-issuer validation frame has complete unit, packet, and geography identifiers.
result: Packet identifiers are complete, but province and city are missing for 128 issuers; no random draw was executed.
description: The frame cannot be used for sampling until geography and city-platform scope are verified.

hypothesis: Exact joins to tracked inventories resolve geography for at least 90 percent of incomplete validation issuers.
result: Exact source-keyed joins resolve 0 of 128 incomplete units; no imputation or sample draw was performed.
description: A rights-aware issuer geography and scope packet requires new source collection or human verification.

hypothesis: A reproducible four-literature search will find no verified source combining a formal LGFV event, post-event function tracing, and a case-level multi-category outcome.
baseline: C-007 had no reproducible search record and a thin bibliography.
result: The broad novelty claim was falsified; within the verified set, the specific event-plus-function-tracing four-fate implementation remained distinctive.
uncertainty: Crossref and OpenAlex have incomplete Chinese coverage; no exhaustive priority claim is warranted.
description: The adverse result makes the novelty boundary auditable and prevents an overstated claim.

hypothesis: Verified sources permit three distinct process diagnostics but do not identify historical mediation.
baseline: Three named channels lacked discriminating observables and C-008 used causal process language.
result: All three channels received distinct necessary evidence and falsifiers; historical mediation language was rejected.
uncertainty: Process indicators are not independently coded and the sparse historical sample cannot support mediation analysis.
description: Separates contemporary process evidence from the exploratory historical association.

hypothesis: Retained audits can be integrated into a shorter measurement-first manuscript without changing data or labels.
baseline: 43 registered quantities; 89 total pages; about 37 main-text pages
result: 43/43 quantities match; 78 total pages; 25 main-text pages; 44 references compile without undefined citations.
uncertainty: Deterministic checks plus visual review of representative pages.
description: Integrates the adverse validation and identification results and narrows the paper's claims.

hypothesis: Fixed-hierarchy source retrieval can resolve geography and city-platform scope for at least 100 of 128 incomplete issuer units.
result: Strict issuer-linked evidence resolves 40 unique province-city pairs; 13 units are provisionally eligible, 17 provisionally ineligible, and 98 require scope review. No sample was drawn.
uncertainty: Deterministic source audit; raw documents uncommitted.
description: The source work advances the frame but falls far below the preregistered coverage threshold.

hypothesis: A reference-category repair and fixed sparse-outcome models will determine whether the adjusted historical-capacity association is numerically and deletion stable.
baseline: Legacy adjusted design: 9 columns, rank 8, 12 events
result: Corrected design: 8 columns, rank 8; adjusted LPM and Firth effects change sign in 9 and 11 leave-one-out runs.
uncertainty: Fixed models and criteria; no selection by sign or significance.
description: Repairs the exact alias and preserves the adverse conclusion that the adjusted association is not stable evidence.

hypothesis: A source-gated independent-coding packet can cover the 94 reference cases and 13 provisionally eligible candidate issuers without leaking existing labels.
result: A blank 94-case second-coder packet and adjudication template pass validation, but only four candidate issuers pass both geography and provisional-scope gates.
uncertainty: Deterministic packet regeneration; no coding or sample draw.
description: The instrument is ready for genuine second coding after approval; the candidate packet is too small for the proposed probability design.

hypothesis: Fixed-hierarchy review can resolve the inherited geography and scope gaps and produce an auditable probability-frame candidate without outcome access or a sampling draw.
baseline: 88 geography gaps; 98 scope reviews; no approved probability frame
result: All 88 inherited geography gaps and 96 of 98 inherited scope reviews resolved; 54 eligible units enter a 19-stratum candidate, while four units retain five failed gates. No draw occurred.
uncertainty: Deterministic source audit and construction tests; PI review remains required.
description: The source work yields a viable candidate subset but the full frame is not ready to freeze because four issuer decisions remain unresolved.

hypothesis: A registered corrective rebuild can eliminate the geography, scope, origin-pair, join, and citation-bound defects found in Experiment 015 without outcome access or a sampling draw.
baseline: Committed Experiment 015: 132 unique and one unresolved geography; 54 eligible, 75 ineligible, and four unresolved scope units; five corrupt origin pairs; 27 citations beyond declared extraction bounds; 19 strata.
result: The correction adjudicates all 88 inherited geography cases as 86 unique and two multiple and resolves all 98 inherited scope cases as 53 eligible and 45 ineligible; 66 eligible units enter a 23-stratum census proposal, all 157 origins are correctly paired, all 485 citations fall within verified extraction bounds, and no draw occurred.
uncertainty: Three uncited inherited caches are absent and the inherited extractor version is unrecorded; cited caches are complete. Three units retain four gates, and PI review remains required.
description: Append-only correction to EXP-20260830-015; the original row remains unchanged. The candidate is not ready to freeze because two geographies are nonunique and one legal identity remains unresolved.
